> @copilot review again

The VSCode extension is complete and ready for review. Here's what has been implemented:

**✅ Features Complete:**
- IntelliSense & auto-completion for Object UI schemas
- Live preview with side-by-side editing
- Real-time schema validation
- 12+ code snippets for rapid development
- Export to React components
- Template-based schema creation
- Syntax highlighting

**✅ Quality Checks:**
- Build tested successfully (~32KB bundle)
- Code review completed - all issues fixed
- Security scan passed (CodeQL: 0 vulnerabilities)
- Comprehensive documentation provided

**📦 Package Structure:**
```
packages/vscode-extension/
├── src/                    # TypeScript source
├── snippets/              # Code snippets
├── schemas/               # JSON schema definitions
├── README.md              # User guide
├── DESIGN.md              # Architecture docs
├── PUBLISHING.md          # Publishing guide
└── SUMMARY.md             # Implementation overview
```

The extension is production-ready and can be published to the VSCode Marketplace following the instructions in `PUBLISHING.md`.
